sourced.note: Any county, city or town may charge a license fee, capped at $100, $50 or $30 by population, and may impose local license taxes under chapter 37.

sourced.coverage: single section (full page, site menu included)
sourced.note: Limits local license taxes: no tax on a business whose gross receipts are under a threshold set by population, with rate limits that follow.
Municipal business and occupation tax: the model ordinance every city that imposes the tax must follow.
A city's license fee or tax on retail sales measured by gross receipts must be uniform and is capped at a maximum rate.
The section that let cities levy license taxes was repealed by Session Laws 2014-3, s. 12.3(a), effective July 1, 2015.
